summary: Charming two-bedroom terraced house in a sought-after town location. Features spacious living areas, modern kitchen, and private garden. Close to local amenities and transport links. Ideal for professionals or small families. Unfurnished and available mid-November.
description:
This charming two-bedroom terraced house is ideally situated in a sought-after residential area, offering a comfortable and convenient lifestyle. The property boasts a well-proportioned living room, filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is practical and spacious, equipped with ample storage and work surfaces, perfect for everyday cooking.

Both bedrooms are generously sized, providing flexibility for a small family, professionals, or as a home office space. private rear yard, offering a peaceful outdoor space for relaxation.

Located close to local amenities, schools, and excellent transport links, this unfurnished property presents an ideal opportunity for those seeking a comfortable home in a convenient location. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the potential of this delightful terraced house. Available immediately, this property is ready to welcome its new occupants.
